title: Migration runner comment warns about out-of-order silently skipping but runner uses snapshot current version
description: The comment at MIGRATIONS declaration (lib.rs line 394) warns: 'Adding migrations out of order will silently skip them if user_version already exceeds their target.' This is correct but the warning is easy to miss since it's separated from the actual check logic. The migrate() function comment (line 462-468) separately explains the snapshot behavior. These two comments should be unified into a single clear note at the migrate() function itself: 'Migrations must be listed in ascending version order. A migration whose target version <= current user_version is skipped permanently. Adding a migration at a lower version after deployment silently no-ops.' This is readability-only; the logic is correct.
